distractors.reason: We don't say 'watch strongly'. 'Strongly' describes force or firm belief, not careful attention.
We don't say 'watch loudly'. 'Loudly' describes sound, so it does not fit the action of watching.
We don't say 'watch quickly' to mean paying attention. 'Quickly' describes speed, not care.

example_sentence: Please watch your bag ___ in a crowded station.
l1_interference: Носії української часто ставлять прислівник перед дієсловом, тому кажуть 'carefully watch' замість правильного 'watch carefully'. В англійській прислівник зазвичай стоїть після дієслова.
explanation: In English, many adverbs of manner come after the verb they describe. 'Carefully' tells us how someone watches, so it follows 'watch'.

related_collocations.example: Please listen carefully to the police instructions.
Always lock your door securely before you go to sleep.
Drive carefully when the roads are wet.

memory_tip: Adverbs of manner usually come AFTER the verb: watch carefully, lock securely, drive carefully
